title: Healing and holy aura: glowing rune circle on the ground, light column, rising sparkles
summary: A spell circle on the ground (bright outer ring, a band of runes turning slowly, an inner hexagram sigil turning the other way, a soft glowing disc, pulse waves running outward, sparkling dust), a soft light column rising from it, CPUParticles3D sparkles drifting up (plus signs for heal, four-point stars for the others) and a coloured light. Visual only. Presets heal (green), holy (gold), mana (blue), arcane (violet), rage (red), frost (cyan).
use_when: Healing spells, a healing fountain or shrine, a save point, a resurrection / respawn point, buff or mana zones, a summoning or ritual circle, a quest objective marker, a boss AoE telegraph (rage preset), a campfire rest spot, an area-of-effect spell.
how_to_use: var a := preload("res://starter/shader-healing-aura/healing_aura.tscn").instantiate(); add_child(a); a.position = spot_on_ground; a.radius = 2.0 (m); a.preset = "heal" (heal, holy, mana, arcane, rage, frost). Origin = ground centre (the circle sits 3 cm above it). a.pulse(1.5) flashes the circle and column (call it from your own code, e.g. when a heal lands); the aura detects nothing itself. Exports: beam (true), beam_height (4 m), intensity (0..2), sparkles (true), light_energy (1.6). The ground shader alone: aura_ground.gdshader on a PlaneMesh (UV 0..1 spans the circle). Needs Environment glow_enabled = true for the glow.

contents.what: HealingAura (Node3D): Circle plane, Beam cylinder, Motes (CPUParticles3D), Light
presets, radius, beam, intensity, sparkles, light_energy, pulse()
ground circle: outer ring, rotating rune band, counter-rotating sigil, disc, pulse waves, dust

provenance: original shaders and scripts written by Summer for the shelf (s06-fantasy); no third-party code (the Eclipse divine VFX of unknown licence was not used)

verified.notes: demo.tscn rendered in Compatibility and Forward+ (Summer 4.7.2, macOS, 1280x720 saves) with 0 SCRIPT ERROR / shader compile errors; fresh_test (clean cloud project, pack only) imports and renders in Compatibility with no errors. Not run in a real browser (WebGL2) or on the cloud's Linux/Mesa GL; shaders avoid compute and long loops.
